title: Objectwise algebra-linear lift of the pullback adjoint
statement: Let $f:U\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A=f_*\mathcal O_U$, $\rho:\mathcal O_X\to A$ the structure map, $R$ pushforward of modules to A-module sheaves and $S$ restriction along $\rho$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $I=f^{-1}$ on A-modules and $IA=f^{-1}A$, $r_0:f^{-1}\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_U$ for the structure map, $t_0=f^{-1}\rho$, and $e:IA\to\mathcal O_U$ for the ring-sheaf counit. Let $b:\mathcal O_U\to B$ and $t:IA\to B$ form a pushout of $r_0,t_0$, and let $\epsilon:B\to\mathcal O_U$ satisfy $b\epsilon=1$ and $t\epsilon=e$. Let $P$ be a functor from A-module sheaves to B-module sheaves, with specified identifications $P(G)=B\otimes_{IA}I(G)$ and map $P(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes I(a)$. Let $\kappa:P\operatorname{Res}_b\simeq S f^*$ be a natural isomorphism, where $f^*$ is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $H$ be a functor to $\mathcal O_U$-modules, with specified identifications $H(G)=\mathcal O_U\otimes_B P(G)$ and map $H(a)$ the transported sheafification of $1\otimes P(a)$. Let $\gamma:S f^*\to H$ be natural. All tensor products here have the scalar factor first and are sheafified [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $\theta_t,\theta_\epsilon$ denote their sheafification units and $\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}$ the inverse-image/direct-image unit on underlying abelian sheaves. For every open $V$ of X and section $g\in G(V)$ assume, after the specified object identifications, $\kappa_G^{-1}(\eta^{f^*}_{SG,V}(g))=\theta_t(1\otimes\eta^{\mathrm{ab}}_{G,V}(g))$ over $f^{-1}V$, where $\eta^{f^*}$ is the unit of the canonical adjunction of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For every open W of U and $p\in P(G)(W)$ assume $\gamma_G(\kappa_G(p))=\theta_\epsilon(1\otimes p)$. Then for every A-module sheaf G there exists an A-linear morphism $a_G:G\to R(HG)$ whose scalar restriction is the canonical pullback adjoint of $\gamma_G$.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 01SB (lemma-affine-equivalence-modules), construction of h and elucidation

proof.text: The pullback adjoint is the pullback unit followed by pushforward of gamma. The hP tensor-unit formula identifies its section after kappa inverse with the sheafification of 1 tensor eta(g), and hH identifies the subsequent extension along epsilon.

For a in A(V), inverse-image linearity gives eta(a g)=eta(a) eta(g). Move eta(a) first to the B factor along t by the balanced relation and then through epsilon in the second tensor product. The identity t epsilon=e and the ring adjunction triangle evaluate this scalar to a in R(HG). Thus the adjoint is A-linear, with its existing additivity and restriction compatibility. This defines a_G with exactly the required restricted map. Zero rings and empty opens satisfy the same calculation.

proof_origin.note: Details of the tensor construction and elucidation of Stacks 01SB, read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01SB.

theorem affine_module_tensor_unitLift
    (B : U.toTopCat.Sheaf CommRingCat.{u}) (b : U.sheaf ⟶ B) (t : IA ⟶ B)
    (ε : B ⟶ U.sheaf) (hpush : IsPushout r₀ t₀ b t)
    (hb : b ≫ ε = 𝟙 U.sheaf) (ht : t ≫ ε = e₀)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B))
        (pobj : ∀ G, P.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} t (I G))
        (κ : P ⋙ SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 b) ≅ S ⋙ tensorPullback f)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A) ⥤ U.Modules)
          (hobj : ∀ G, H.obj G = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))
          (γ : S ⋙ tensorPullback f ⟶ H)
    (hP :
        (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
          P.map a = eqToHom (pobj G) ≫
            SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} t (I G)
              (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap f.base A G a) ≫
            eqToHom (pobj G').symm) ∧
        (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (g : G.val.obj V),
          ((eqToHom (pobj G)).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
            ((κ.inv.app G).val.app ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
              (((adj₀).unit.app ((S).obj G)).val.app V g)) =
            ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 B).obj)).unit.app
              (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} t (I G))).app
                ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)
                ((1 : B.obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V))
                  ⊗ₜ[(IA).obj.obj ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V),(t.hom.app
                    ((Opens.map f.base).op.obj V)).hom]
                  (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
                    (Opens.map f.base) AddCommGrpCat.{u} (𝓙 X) (𝓙 U)).unit.app
                      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (𝓡 A)).obj G)).hom.app V g))))
    (hH :
          (∀ (G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (a : G ⟶ G'),
            H.map a = eqToHom (hobj G) ≫
              SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G) (P.map a) ≫
              eqToHom (hobj G').symm) ∧
          (∀ (G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A)) (W : (Opens U)ᵒᵖ)
              (p : (P.obj G).val.obj W),
            ((eqToHom (hobj G)).val.app W)
              ((γ.app G).val.app W ((κ.hom.app G).val.app W p)) =
              ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 U.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app
                (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} ε (P.obj G))).app W
                  ((1 : U.sheaf.obj.obj W) ⊗ₜ[B.obj.obj W,(ε.hom.app W).hom] p))) :
    ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 A),
      ∃ a : G ⟶ (R).obj (H.obj G),
        (S).map a = ((adj₀).homEquiv ((S).obj G) (H.obj G)) (γ.app G)
